PropertySetDef.Name: Pset_BeamCommon
PropertySetDef.Definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all IfcBeam.

PropertyDef.Name: Reference
PropertyDef.Definition: Reference ID for this beam type in this project (e.g. type "B-1")

PropertyDef.Name: Depth
PropertyDef.Definition: Specified or derived depth of the beam. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

PropertyDef.Name: Width
PropertyDef.Definition: Specified or derived witdth of the beam. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

PropertyDef.Name: Span
PropertyDef.Definition: Clear span for this beam. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

PropertyDef.Name: Camber
PropertyDef.Definition: Measure that design of beam rises in the center in order to prevent beam sagging under loading and over time.

PropertyDef.Name: SectionModulus
PropertyDef.Definition: Calculated section modulus for this beam

PropertyDef.Name: Slope
PropertyDef.Definition: Slope for this stringer - relative to horizontal (0.0 degrees).
